Preserve the double jaw and the same four-limb Burster anatomy through idle, locomotion, inflation/detonation preparation and terminal collapse. Albino changes newly authored pigment and material response only: warm pearl-ivory and pale gray-beige chitin, cool gray recesses, translucent blush-taupe thin tissues and muted yellow-green acid membranes with readable internal fluid; never pure flat white, whole-body fluorescence, neon glow, ice, a filtered base sheet or automatic recolor. Preserve strict right-facing orthographic gameplay profile and stable ribcage/pelvis proportions. Every future pixel must be original project art; canonExact=false.

designDetails.silhouette: Inherit the V66 Burster: lean low quadruped with short cranial plate, large clustered acid blisters across cranium and neck with smaller restrained groups on forelimbs and thighs, narrow ribbed torso, exactly four running limbs, no tall dorsal tubes, and exactly one complete long segmented tail ending in a broad flattened blade.
designDetails.palette: Warm pearl-ivory and pale gray-beige chitin, cool gray biomechanical recesses, restrained rose-taupe translucency at thin tissues, dark desaturated cavities and muted yellow-green acid membranes with readable internal fluid. The body never becomes uniformly luminous or pure white.
designDetails.surface: Keep ribs, tendons, short plate, blister membranes, joints and tail segmentation readable through value and material contrast. The pale surface and every cyst are newly authored; toy hinges, copied licensed pixels, filtering and automatic recolor artifacts are prohibited.
designDetails.anatomy: One eyeless short-plated head with double jaw and biological cyst clusters, one narrow ribbed torso, exactly two forelegs, two digitigrade hind legs and one continuous tail with one broad blade. No equipment; the explosive charge is biological.
designDetails.orientation: Strict orthographic gameplay profile facing RIGHT in all 32 poses; cranium, cyst groups, four limbs, jaws, entire tail and tail blade stay inside each cell without camera rotation.
designDetails.scale: Use the reviewed Burster body plan and ribcage-to-cranial-plate proportions as anatomical guidance only. The base metadata records a historical final pack scale of 0.5, but scaleCalibrationReview is null and scaleCalibrationEvidence is empty; no per-clip numeric calibration is inherited. The new 068 sources require a complete independent all-clip scale review before acceptance.
designDetails.root: Track the center of the ribcage immediately behind the front shoulder and project it to the actual planted limb or collapsed-body support plane. Cyst inflation, tail blade, cranium contour and detonation anticipation never redefine the physical root.
designDetails.attackRead: Eight chronological poses must show brace, progressive biological pressure/inflation, terminal preparation and recovery or committed terminal hold without turning the body into a sphere. The final acid burst, damage radius and splash are separate runtime effects and are not embedded across cells.
designDetails.background: True transparent RGBA when available, otherwise perfectly uniform pure #FF00FF; no acid splash, shadow, scenery, hive resin, text, logo or grid.
